executiveSummary: Multiple government advisories and vendor reports confirm active, OT-relevant threat activity at the edge and within operations-supporting systems. Pro-Russia hacktivists are opportunistically accessing internet-exposed HMIs via VNC and changing setpoints; U.S. water sector PLCs have been locked and reconfigured; and pre-auth exploits against widely deployed edge services (NetScaler ADC and Cisco ASA/FTD) are being weaponized in the wild. Concurrently, exploited SQL injection in Metabase enables admin takeover and downstream database credential theft, and hard-coded keys in an OT segmentation platform (JCI Airwall) elevate lateral-movement risk into ICS networks. Defensive priority is immediate exposure reduction, rapid patching of edge/KEV items, and validation of segmentation and monitoring on OT conduits. Pro-Russia hacktivists are actively abusing exposed VNC on OT HMIs (water, energy, food/ag). Confirmed loss-of-view and parameter changes require immediate removal of internet-facing VNC and strong authentication. Security Advisory CISA warns of increased activity targeting PLCs in the U.S. Water/Wastewater sector (password changes, IP reconfigs, manual mode/boil-water). Security Advisory NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-8452) has public PoC; disable/lock down SAML SP/IdP and patch per vendor guidance. Advisory Cisco ASA/FTD Remote Access SSL VPN flaw (CVE-2026-20349) is exploited to force device reloads (DoS); federal KEV listing increases urgency. View Article KEV Notice Metabase SQLi (CVE-2026-72898/72899) is under active exploitation to seize admin access and harvest DB credentials; block /api/session/reset_password and patch. Advisory Johnson Controls Airwall identical key (CVE-2026-64887) undermines OT network segmentation/micro-segmentation controls until upgraded and keys rotated. ICS Advisory China-nexus actors continue using large covert SOHO/IoT botnets to route intrusions and pre-position in critical infrastructure-harden edge/IoT and restrict egress. Joint Advisory TrueConf server exploits deliver backdoors used for lateral movement (energy, transport, electronics)-patch and validate installer signatures; hunt for provided IOCs. Supporting Report

descriptions: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190): NetScaler ADC SAML pre-auth RCE; Metabase SQLi; ASA/FTD RA VPN DoS.
Valid Accounts & Brute Force (T1078/T1110.003): VNC to HMIs; FortiGate default/admin creds (Gunra).
Remote Services (T1021.005 / ICS protocols): VNC/RDP; PLC online edits and mode changes (WWS incidents).
Ingress Tool Transfer & Web Shell (T1105/T1505.003): Theme/web directories on NetScaler; IIS web shell for TrueConf.
Exfiltration over Web/Cloud (T1567): OneDrive/Graph C2 and exports (TrueConf campaign); Metabase data export abuse.
Router/Edge Persistence: SNMP Set-Requests & Smart Install (FSB Ctr 16); covert SOHO/IoT botnets (PRC advisory).

outlook72h: Expect scanning and exploitation attempts on NetScaler ADC SAML and ASA/FTD RA portals to continue-complete patching and lock-down within 72 hours. Conduct emergency external surface review: take down any exposed VNC/RDP/PLC/HMI services; implement temporary IP allow-listing where decommissioning is staged. Rotate credentials and tokens tied to Metabase and connected databases; inspect for suspicious admin activity and session anomalies. Increase router/edge telemetry to SIEM (SNMP Set-Requests, Smart Install, TFTP/FTP egress) and validate OOB management isolation.
